prose: Amazon is in talks to buy Decart, the San Francisco AI startup whose software helps developers run models efficiently, in a deal that could value it around $7 billion, per WSJ sources; Anthropic had decided against acquiring Decart for roughly $6 billion in September. Basis: the WSJ article is paywalled and no body text was retrievable, so this summary reflects the reported headline and its context rather than the full article.
highlights: Amazon in talks to acquire AI startup Decart at a ~$7B valuation (WSJ).
Anthropic passed on buying Decart for ~$6B in September.
Decart's software helps developers run AI models efficiently.
Basis: headline only - WSJ paywall blocked the article text.
